The '''KD-36 Bioweapon Dispersal Drone''' was a model of [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] that was used by the freelance [[Spy/Legends|spy]] known as [[The Shroud (Human)|the Shroud]]. It was designed to deploy poisonous gases and bioweapons, and KD-36 drones were deployed to eliminate individuals who were intruding on the Shroud's business.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
KD-36 Bioweapon Dispersal Drones appear as enemies in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', the first Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The KD-36 attacks players who use [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] to scan the Shroud's transmitters on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Voss]].<ref name="TOR" />
